title: Golden workbook fails its own forced-recalculation grading
evidence: The sole verifier, weighted 1, force-recalculates submissions but compares them against the golden workbook's saved caches. Applying that same recalculation to the golden workbook produces regression 1.0000 but modification 0.9617, with 167 mismatches, resulting in a score of 0. For example, Model!I182 changes from -0.111997214653663 to 2.04921163134373, and Model!I121 changes from -3.00406239978358 to -3.08777611992694. The circular cash/debt schedule is not saved in a settled calculation state, so even the supplied expected solution fails the grading pipeline.
confirmation: Same defect: the verifier forces LibreOffice recalculation of the output but compares to the golden's Excel caches for the circular Model cash/debt schedule, and the golden itself recalculates to 167 mismatches (e.g. Model!I121 -3.004 vs -3.088).

title: Golden ground-truth workbook fails its own verifier under LibreOffice recalculation and leaves a broken cross-sheet sign reference (`Model!D169`) unfixed
evidence:
The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight: 1) requires `mod_ratio == 1.0` and `reg_ratio >= 0.998` after force-recalculating `output_path` in LibreOffice (`managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True)`), while reading `gt_path` (`gt_10_golden.xlsx`) and `reference_path` (`untouched_input_Incorrect Cross Sheet References_input.xlsx`) without LibreOffice recalculation. Two defects make the golden solution invalid:
1. `Model` has an iterative circular reference (`iterate="true" iterateCount="100" iterateDelta="0.0001"`) in the ABL debt sweep (`Model!I195:M195` references Ending Cash `I$182:M$182`, which sums `I195:M195`, creating an undamped period-2 oscillation across iterations). Although none of the 3 formula/value edits between input and golden (`Model!D52`, `Model!F150`, `4-Wall Analysis!B439`) change the formulas in `Model!I121:M207`, saving `gt_10_golden.xlsx` in Excel shifted 167 cells in `Model!I121:T31` and `P&L Summary!G40:T8` to a different oscillating state (`Model!I195` changed from `0` to `-3.072701`). When `gt_10_golden.xlsx` itself is passed into `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, LibreOffice recalculates `Model!I195` to `-0.848706` and fails 167 modification cells (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9617. 167 cell error(s): Modification error at Model!I121: answer=-3.00406239978358, output=-3.08777611992694...`, score = 0.0).
2. `gt_10_golden.xlsx` leaves `Model!D169` (`(+) CapEx` for FY24) as `='FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil` (`-1.80978586`), whereas all other historical columns (`C169`, `E169`, `F169`) negate the negative cash-flow cell (`=-'FY2023A (CF)'!O37/Mil`, `=-'FY2025A (CF)'!O37/Mil`, `=-'FY2026A (YTD CF)'!O37/Mil`). Because `Model!D134` (`(-) CapEx`) is `=-D169`, the unfixed `D169` flips the sign of FY24 CapEx in Unlevered Free Cash Flow (`D134 = +1.80978586` instead of `-1.80978586`, inflating `D137` UFCF from `3.788795` to `7.408366`). All 3 agent runs identified and fixed `Model!D169`, and were penalized for doing so.
confirmation: Golden Model!D169 is "='FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil" while C169, E169, F169 negate the source, flipping D134 '(-) CapEx' to +1.81; run grade.json shows agents fixing it failed at Model!D137 (answer 7.408, output 3.789), and the golden also self-fails due to the iterative circular block.
fix: D169 sign fixed in the golden; golden passes its own check (see gt-replay-0).

title: The ground-truth workbook fails its own verifier after LibreOffice recalculates it, so no output can pass
evidence: The single verifier (verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells, weight 1, pass/fail) recalculates every output in LibreOffice (managed_recalculated_xlsx, force_recalculation=True). It then needs 100% of modification cells to match the cached values in gt_10_golden.xlsx, which were computed in Excel. I copied gt_10_golden.xlsx, recalculated it through the verifier's own managed_recalculated_xlsx, and scored it with score_workbooks. The result was regression 1.0 but modification 0.9617, with 167 modification-cell errors, so the verifier returns 0.0. Examples: Model!I121 GT=-3.00406 vs LO=-3.08778; Model!I181 GT=-1.11200 vs LO=+1.04921; Model!I195 (Paydown) GT=-3.07270 vs LO=-0.84871; Model!J181 GT=-1.17854 vs LO=0; Model!K186 GT=27.773 vs LO=31.957. The cause is a circular debt/interest/cash loop. The GT workbook sets iterate=True, iterateCount=100, iterateDelta=0.0001. I121 '=-SUM(-I183,I197,I199:I200,I207)', I181 '=I146+I194+I195+I205' and I195 '=IF($H201=0,0,MIN(MAX((-I193+-I194),-(I146+I194+(I$182-$K$11))),0))' depend on each other, and LibreOffice's iterative solve lands on different values than Excel did. These interest/debt/cash cells sit downstream of the Model!D52 and F150 fixes, so they count as modification cells. Even a perfect copy of the GT file therefore scores 0.
confirmation: The golden workbook has iterate=true with a circular paydown loop (I195 references I) and Excel-cached values that LibreOffice does not reproduce; recalculating the golden gives modification 0.9617 with 167 errors, so even a perfect copy scores 0.
fix: Unconverged circular cells stay out of answer_position (existing exclusion); golden passes its own check.

title: Broad 'audit and fix this file thoroughly' prompt conflicts with exact-cell grading that only expects 3 undisclosed edits and environment lacks advertised Python packages
evidence: In `problem.py:33`, the prompt instructs the agent: `Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability.` However, `gt_10_golden.xlsx` only modifies 3 cells across the 294,669 graded cells in `answer_position`: `Model!D52` (`'FY2023A (IS)'!O17/Mil` -> `'FY2024A (IS)'!O17/Mil`), `Model!F150` (`'FY2026A (YTD BS)'!N11/Mil` -> `'FY2026A (YTD BS)'!H11/Mil`), and `4-Wall Analysis!B439` (`SAIL16` -> `SAIL15`). The workbook contains numerous other genuine formula errors within `answer_position` that are left unfixed in `gt_10_golden.xlsx` — including `Model!D169` (missing minus sign on cross-sheet reference `'FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil`), 29 literal `=#REF!` cells across `FY2024A (Earnings)!C5:N5`, `FY2027P (IS)!K33:N33`, `FY2027P (Earnings)!A1`, and `FY2028P (IS)!A3:A4,C9,L9,C33:N33`, `Model!F218` multiplying by `$C$310` before `Model!F220` multiplies by `C310` again, and `Model!I195:M195` referencing Ending Cash `I$182:M$182` instead of Beginning Cash `I180:M180`. Fixing any of these defects causes `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) to penalize the agent. Additionally, `problem.py:10` states the agent can use `Pandas`, `openpyxl`, `numpy`, but those packages are only installed in `<tool-server dir>/.venv` (`drwx------ root:root`), which `model` cannot access, causing all 3 runs to fail `import openpyxl` and offline `pip install` in their opening steps.
confirmation: The golden makes only 3 edits (Model!D52, F150, '4-Wall Analysis'!B439) under a 'fix thoroughly' prompt and leaves real errors like Model!D169's missing minus, which run grades penalize; the run trajectories also show 'No module named openpyxl' although the prompt promises openpyxl.
fix: Key now also fixes the named Model!F218 =(0.5*(843375))/1000000*$C$310 -> =(0.5*(843375))/1000000 (F220 already multiplies by C310; value unchanged while the flag is 1) and Model!I195:M195 paydown (I$182-$K$11) -> (I180-$K$11) (beginning cash). The 33 literal =#REF! cells it names ('FY2024A (Earnings)'!C5:N5, 'FY2027P (IS)'!K33:N33, 'FY2027P (Earnings)'!A1, 'FY2028P (IS)'!A3:A4, C9, L9, C33:N33) have no single defensible repair (the deleted references cannot be recovered), so verifications[0].answer_position now skips them; grader guidance range text matches. The missing openpyxl is an environment issue, not changed here.

title: Answer key penalizes a formula correction explicitly required by the audit
evidence: The instructions request a thorough audit including 'formula logic errors or inconsistencies', but the golden workbook retains a demonstrably reversed CapEx sign. Model!D169, labeled '(+) CapEx', uses ='FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil and returns -1.80978586; neighboring historical CapEx formulas negate the cash-flow outflow. Consequently, Model!D134, labeled '(-) CapEx', incorrectly adds 1.80978586 to free cash flow. Correcting D169 to negate the source changes the graded modification cell Model!D137 from the key's 7.40836635786565 to 3.78879463786565. This exceeds the verifier's 1% tolerance and independently fails its requirement that every modification cell match, losing the entire weight-1 score for performing the requested audit correctly.
confirmation: Golden D169 lacks the negation used in C169/E169/F169, and the run grades show correcting it fails Model!D137 (answer 7.40836635786565 vs output 3.78879463786565), beyond the 1% tolerance, zeroing the score.
fix: Model!D169 is =-'FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil in the key, so D134/D137 match a correct fix.

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: The ground truth graded by the real grader scored 0, consistent with the independently reproduced 167 circular-reference mismatches after LibreOffice recalculation of the golden; the guess that the file 'never reached the grader' is wrong, but the golden-fails-grader problem is real.
fix:
The rebuilt golden scores 1.0 on the cell check: same D169 fix and loop-cell exclusion, and the 84 '4-Wall Analysis' label formulas (e.g. BS5 =R4) whose cached text 'Beloeil,
Quebec' fails against the recalculated 'Beloeil, Quebec' now carry the recalculated text.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` scores 0.0 on all runs and on the golden workbook itself due to LibreOffice-vs-Excel circular reference divergence and unfixed `Model!D169`
evidence: Across all 3 comparison units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) scored `0.0`: unit 1 scored `regression 1.0000, modification 0.0082`, while unit 2 (`modification 0.9572, 640 cell error(s)`) and unit 3 (`modification 0.9572, 602 cell error(s)`) both found and applied all 3 golden edits (`Model!D52 = ='FY2024A (IS)'!O17/Mil`, `Model!F150 = ='FY2026A (YTD BS)'!H11/Mil`, `4-Wall Analysis!B439 = 'SAIL15'`) in addition to fixing the genuine cross-sheet sign bug at `Model!D169 = -'FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil`. Independent evaluation shows that `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` requires `mod_ratio == 1.0` (0 modification errors out of 4,365 modification cells) to return `1.0`, otherwise returning `0.0`. However, because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` force-recalculates only `output_path` in LibreOffice (`managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True)`) and compares it against the raw Excel-cached values in `gt_10_golden.xlsx`, the non-convergent circular reference in `Model!I180:M207` (`I195` referencing `I$182`) evaluates to different numbers in LibreOffice than in Excel's saved cache. Passing `gt_10_golden.xlsx` directly as `output_path` to `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` produces `score=0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9617. 167 cell error(s)`), making it impossible for any LibreOffice-recalculated submission to pass.
confirmation: gt_10_golden.xlsx has iterative calc on (calcPr iterate=true, 100 iterations) with a circular cash/debt sweep in Model rows 180-207, and the verifier recalculates only the output in LibreOffice against Excel-cached golden values; the golden-replay check and two independent diagnostics report the gol
fix: gt_10_golden.xlsx rebuilt from the original: Model!D169 ='FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil -> =-'FY2024A (CF)'!O37/Mil (as C169, E169, F169); dependents' cached values recomputed (Model, P&L Summary; 523+32 cells). answer_position keeps the existing exclusion of the cells in or downstream of the iterative cash/debt loop (Model I:M rows 121-207, AV:AX rows 20-43, P&L Summary R7:T8, G40:K41).
